<infobox>
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>
  <image source="image1">
    <caption source="caption1"/>
  </image>
  <group>
    <header>Production</header>
    <data source="directors">
      <label>Directors</label>
    </data>
    <data source="executive_producers">
      <label>Executive Producers</label>
    </data>
    <data source="writers">
      <label>Writers</label>
    </data>
    <data source="production_companies">
      <label>Production Companies</label>
    </data>
    <data source="production_locations">
      <label>Production Locations</label>
    </data>
    <data source="release_date">
      <label>Release Date</label>
    </data>
  </group>
  <group>
    <header>Release</header>
    <data source="network">
      <label>Network</label>
    </data>
  </group>
</infobox>
